article.title: Proof of signature and handwriting of person alleged to have signed or written document produced
article.content: If a document is alleged to be signed or to have been written wholly or in part by any person, the signature or the handwriting of so much of the document as is alleged to be in that person's handwriting must be proved to be in his handwriting.
article.html:
65Proof of signature and handwriting of person alleged to have signed or written document produced

Section 65 · Part III · Chapter V

If a document is alleged to be signed or to have been written wholly or in part by any person, the signature or the handwriting of so much of the document as is alleged to be in that person's handwriting must be proved to be in his handwriting.
